text:
Tom Chen: deploy-bot paused canary in eu-west: secret rotation ordering mismatch — canary pods reporting 503s.
Sara Lin: saw the alert, looking.
Kevin M: which secret? certs or app creds?
Tom Chen: it's the session-secret rotated by ops pipeline; canary got new value, stable still on old. stack traces show auth failures.
Priya Rao: Logs: `2026-03-21T14:23:11Z error auth: token mismatch` — canary pods pulled latest chart with postUpgrade hook that rotates secret.
Sara Lin: deploy-bot health: `Canary 10/100 healthy -> paused`
ops-bot: rotation run id `rot-2026-5162` completed at 14:22:56 across regions, but eu-west agent lagged.
Kevin M: Options: 1) rollback canary to previous chart, 2) hotpatch canary to skip hook, 3) complete rotation on stable ASAP, 4) route traffic away.
Tom Chen: I'm leaning rollback to be safe. Any objections?
Priya Rao: +1 rollback. Hotpatch risky unless we can guarantee no data loss with mismatched secret.
Sara Lin: I'll kick `helm rollback release-name 1 --namespace prod-eu` and pause promotions.
Tom Chen: thanks — also update release notes: note secret rotation race and include mitigation steps.
deploy-bot: Starting rollback of `release-name` from 2 -> 1. Preflight: running.
Kevin M: after rollback, let's add canary gating to require secret rotation to finish in all regions before chart with hook gets promoted.
Sara Lin: noted. Adding `rotation.complete` check into canary gate and drafting release note blurb.
ops-bot: Confirmed: eu-west agent caught up at 14:30:12; rotation status: succeeded.
Tom Chen: Rollback completed. Canary health back to 100/100 after 2 minutes.
Sara Lin: Release notes draft: "Canary rollout paused due to secret rotation ordering mismatch between regions; rollback executed to maintain stability. Added gating to prevent promotion until rotation converges."
Kevin M: +1 on wording. Pushing to release-notes draft.
Priya Rao: Follow-up action: make rotation idempotent and add cross-region barrier. Filed ticket INF-7823.
Tom Chen: thanks team. closing thread. :white_check_mark:
